newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The State Ownership Fund (FPS) opened a business centre at Bucharest's World Trade Centre on Wednesday. The centre is designed to inform foreign investors on Romania's privatisation offer.
The FPS is expected to sign a contract to sell 51 percent of plane maker IAR Brasov to U.S. helicopter maker Bell Helicopter Textron .
* Parliament's foreign policy commissions have started to hear candidates for ambassadors to several European capitals.
* Upper Senate's economic commission rejected the government ordinance setting a road tax, saying the measure will increase high taxation in Romania. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
